text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu... I've got you cornered now! 
Teio-chan, Dants-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You two can become even more magnificent 
Umamusume! Nail a smash success! Let's 
make our future shine super-duper bright☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No no nooo!! Anything but the bamboo 
acupuncture, NOOO!! Don't you dare poke 
me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should ask to get pouted at 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, why are you the one acting 
surprised?!!"

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Are you sure about this, 
Dantsu-chan? It's not just a little 
prick♡, okay? It's a full-on *stab*! Don't 
you get it?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm totally fine! After all, I want 
to become an amazing Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Dants~~, please reconsider! Are you really 
okay with this? If she gets all sulky... 
things might turn into a totally messy 
chaotic disaster, y'know!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's fine. After all, 
Anshinzawa-san is only doing this 
procedure for our sake. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
*Panting*... Oh no, where should I stab 
first!? Right, that pressure point Master 
taught me the other day—maybe I could test 
it on these kids... no, I mean, treat 
them—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
See?! She's definitely a quack!! 
Tazuna-san?! Tazuna-saaan?!
